Commands:
/start — main menu and Mini App
/help — this message
/actionbutton — how to set up the iPhone Action Button
/backtap — how to set up Back Tap
actionbutton_guide:
📱 Action Button setup (iPhone 15+):
1. Open Settings → Action Button.
2. Choose the "Shortcut" action.
3. Pick the QK NOTES shortcut (add it via the button below in Mini App → Settings → Quick Actions).
4. Now pressing the Action Button starts voice capture and sends it to the bot.
backtap_guide:
📱 Back Tap setup (iPhone):
1. Open Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap.
2. Choose Double Tap or Triple Tap.
3. Pick the QK NOTES shortcut (created in Mini App → Settings → Quick Actions).
4. Now double/triple tapping the back of your phone starts voice capture and sends it to the bot.
